items.exampleEn: Rumors spread fast in a small town.
items.exampleZh: 在小鎮上，謠言傳得很快。

items.exampleEn: You can download the forms from our website.
items.exampleZh: 你可以從我們的網站下載表格。

items.exampleEn: What do you suggest I buy for my mom?
items.exampleZh: 你建議我買什麼給我媽媽？

items.exampleEn: I have to finish my book report tonight.
items.exampleZh: 我今晚得完成讀書報告。

items.exampleEn: Please speak in a quiet voice in the library.
That sounds like a great idea!
items.exampleZh: 聽起來是個很棒的主意！

items.exampleEn: We sent the letter, but there was no response.
items.exampleZh: 我們寄了信，但沒有收到任何回覆。

items.exampleEn: My parents never argue in front of us.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽從不在我們面前吵架。

items.exampleEn: Her statement was short and clear.

items.sentenceEn: Can you download this song for me?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以幫我下載這首歌嗎？

items.audioEn: I heard a strange sound from the kitchen last night.
items.audioZh: 我昨晚聽到廚房傳來奇怪的聲音。
items.questionZh: 說話的人昨晚聽到什麼？

items.sentenceEn: My brothers always argue about the TV.
items.sentenceZh: 我的兄弟們老是為了電視吵架。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't believe every rumor you hear.
items.sentenceZh: 不要聽到什麼傳言都相信。

items.stemEn: The weather ____ says it will rain tomorrow.
items.stemZh: 氣象報告說明天會下雨。

items.passageEn: Last week, there was a rumor at school: our teacher was leaving. Students argued about it at lunch. Some said it was true, and others did not believe it. Then the headteacher made a statement on the school website: the rumor was not true. Our teacher read it to us in a happy voice. She suggested that we always check the facts before we share news. Her response made everyone laugh: "I'm not going anywhere!"
items.passageZh: 上週學校傳出一個謠言：我們的老師要離開了。同學們在午餐時為此爭論，有人說是真的，有人不相信。後來校長在學校網站上發表正式說明：這個謠言不是真的。老師用開心的聲音念給我們聽。她建議我們分享新聞前一定要先查證。她的回應讓大家都笑了：「我哪裡都不去！」

questions.questionZh: 同學們午餐時在做什麼？
options: 爭論老師要離開的謠言
每天放學後多去圖書館

referenceEn: I like the sound of rain.
I love the sound of the rain.
rubricZh: 「⋯的聲音」可寫例如 the sound of rain

items.instructionZh: 用 suggest 造一個句子，向朋友提出一個建議。
referenceEn: I suggest that we take the bus.
I suggest going to the beach this weekend.
rubricZh: suggest 後面可接例如 that 子句或動名詞（suggest that we…、suggest going）
不寫 suggest to＋原形動詞

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：例句 "That sounds like a great idea!" 示範的是動詞「聽起來」，但干擾項「顏色／味道／形狀」都是名詞，與例句用法對不上；建議例句改名詞用法（如 the sound of rain）或干擾項改動詞義（看起來／聞起來／嚐起來除外的動詞）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["顏色；看起來","味道；嚐起來","形狀；摸起來"]（原 ["顏色","味道","形狀"]）；釋義並列名詞「聲音」與動詞「聽起來」（皆 A2），干擾項改成同樣並列名詞＋動詞義，和例句的動詞用法對得上

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：正解選項明顯是最長的一個（「爭論老師要離開的謠言」10 字 vs 3–4 字），違反「正解不落在最長集合」；應縮短正解或加長干擾項。
